desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE IS HERE! 🎃

Run faster, train harder, and become the fastest HUSS ever!

👻 NEW: THE HAUNTED HOLLOW
Step through the Haunted Portal into a spooky graveyard full of crypts, jack-o'-lanterns and zombies!
🧟 Infected: a case roll picks the first zombie! Run, dodge and survive, or tag everyone to spread the infection!
🏁 Candy Race: dodge ghosts, spam the boosters and race to the finish!
🛒 Spend your Candy in the Halloween Shop on potions, treat bags and the Spooky Charm
💪 Unlock 3 Halloween Trainers, up to +50% faster than your best trainer!
🏆 Top the Most Candy, Most 1st Places, Most Infections and Most Survived leaderboards!

🌴 NEW WORLDS: Jungle Temple & Dino Land!
🐾 8 new pets, 2 new lucky blocks and 20 new headbands

🚀 BOOSTS
💎 Premium members get +10% on everything!
👥 Play with a friend for another +10%!

⚡ HOW TO PLAY
Run as far as you can, train in the Hussers, rebirth to go even faster, collect pets and unlock new worlds!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for mor
